cases.name: Kaylee Birdzell
cases.narrative: Police received information she had been murdered and was "put into the garbage at a local apartment complex." They reportedly began searching through the apartment complex’s garbage, and they went to a landfill in Benton County on Aug. 9 to continue searching, where they eventually found her body.
